principle: STICK-SLIP TRACTION HYSTERESIS — contact is not the same thing as tangential lock. Normal contact remains support-bearing while static traction pins a world patch, threshold failure becomes kinetic slip, and static traction may reacquire only at a new displaced patch after slip decays.

novelty.problem: traction-state hysteresis under continuous normal contact and zero custody
novelty.visible_mechanism: The lead foot visibly stays on one marked world patch while the COM overruns it; a held shear threshold precedes an authored break; the same foot then skids while contact persists, slows, and only later locks to a new displaced marked patch.
